title: Stability of plethysm coefficients and modified polynomial induction
summary: Let $h_n$ denote the complete homogeneous symmetric function of degree $n$, $s_ν$ the Schur function indexed by a partition $ν$, and $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ the Hall inner product. The plethysm coefficient $\langle h_n[h_m], s_ν\rangle$ is the multiplicity of the Weyl module $W_ν(\mathbb{C}^N)$ in $\mathrm{Sym}^n(\mathrm{Sym}^m(\mathbb{C}^N))$ whenever $ν$ has at most $N$ parts. For a partition $λ$, let $λ[mn]=(mn-|λ|,λ_1,λ_2,\dots)$. Bowman and Paget proved that $\langle h_n[h_m], s_{λ[mn]}\rangle$ is independent of $m$ and $n$ once $m,n\ge|λ|$.
